summary: Tested new Twilio Programmable Voice BYOK feature (backend endpoints + /phone frontend). Wrote pytest suite of 15 tests — all 15 pass after fixing 2 critical coding bugs in the twilio_voice router (chained VoiceResponse().say(...).hangup() on a Say object was crashing with 500). Backend: config CRUD + fake-creds rejection + unsigned webhook 403 + audio 404 + outbound-without-config 400 all verified. Regression endpoints (/api/providers, /api/agent/kinds, /api/memory/search/status, /api/archive, /api/auth/me) all still green. Frontend: /phone page renders with all 7 required data-testids; phone-status and phone-dialer correctly hidden when unconfigured; /setup/keys page shows phone-tile + phone-goto; Roadmap has 'Phone calling (Twilio)' in the building bucket (not shipped). Also fixed the /phone 'Back to Connect' link that pointed to the wrong /setup-keys path (real route is /setup/keys).

critical.issue: Multiple TwiML-return branches called .hangup() on the result of .say(), which returns a Say verb, not a VoiceResponse. AttributeError → 500 on any unsigned/unknown-number webhook (broke the fail-closed 403 contract). FIXED by testing agent in twilio_voice.py: replaced with raise HTTPException(403) + _twiml_bye helper.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Back to Connect' link pointed to /setup-keys but actual route is /setup/keys — clicking Back landed on landing page. FIXED in Phone.jsx line 135.

action_items: Review the two testing-agent fixes in /app/backend/routers/twilio_voice.py (voice_incoming no-cfg branch, voice_turn no-doc/no-cfg branches, MAX_TURNS and empty-speech branches) — all now use raise HTTPException(403) or the _twiml_bye helper. Behavior change: an incoming call to a Twilio number that doesn't map to any user now returns 403 instead of a hangup TwiML. That's still safe for production (Twilio will play its own 'application error' fallback) but if you want a graceful hangup instead, replace those 403s with `return _twiml_bye('...')`.
Review the Phone.jsx Back link fix (/setup-keys → /setup/keys). Alternative: add an alias route so both paths work.
Consider: request review-request said 'Frontend /setup-keys page' but the actual route is '/setup/keys'. Either update the review request wording or add an alias route for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: TwiML API misuse — VoiceResponse().say(x).hangup() is broken (Say object has no .hangup). Always append verbs to the VoiceResponse itself: r=VoiceResponse(); r.say(x); r.hangup(); str(r). Two occurrences remain in helper patterns that are safe (_twiml_bye) but the bug pattern repeated 5 times across the file — worth a lint rule.

Signature validation ordering: voice_incoming looks up user by 'To' number BEFORE validating the Twilio signature. That's correct (auth_token is per-user) but note this means an attacker can enumerate which numbers are registered by observing 403-vs-hangup differences. Consider constant-time behavior if that matters.
AUDIO_CACHE is a process-local Python dict — will not survive backend restarts or scale to >1 backend replica. Documented in module docstring but worth revisiting if you ever run multi-replica.

outbound_call inserts twilio_calls with call_sid=None first, then updates. The unique-sparse index on call_sid handles this correctly, but the seed_id-based lookup means orphaned 'dialing' rows can accumulate on Twilio API errors (they get status='failed' so at least they're marked).

_twin_reply iterates prior_turns and calls chat.send_message inside the loop just to seed context — this makes MULTIPLE round-trips to Claude per phone turn. On a call with 8 prior turns you'll do 9 Anthropic calls before responding. Latency will be noticeable. Consider building a single seeded UserMessage or using system-message context instead.

PUBLIC_URL derivation uses os.environ at import time — if PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set after import, it won't take effect until restart. Backend/.env has it set correctly to preview URL, so fine in this env.

rca of the issue: AttributeError 500 on unsigned webhooks: VoiceResponse().say('...').hangup() — the .say() method returns a twilio.twiml.voice_response.Say verb, NOT the VoiceResponse. Only VoiceResponse has .hangup(). This chained-call pattern is wrong per Twilio Python SDK docs. Fix: assign VoiceResponse to a variable and call .say() and .hangup() separately on it, then str() to serialize. Reproduction: curl -X POST '<backend>/api/twilio/voice/incoming' -d 'CallSid=x&From=+1&To=+1' with no X-Twilio-Signature → 500 (before fix) / 403 (after fix). Second bug: Phone.jsx Back link → /setup-keys (nonexistent route), actual is /setup/keys → landed on / (landing page). Fixed.
